## Server

### Fixed

- A mod that is running is always listed. A plugin left in the mods folder without its `waygate-mod.json` (a removal that could delete the manifest but not a dll another process still held open) was loaded all the same while `status.json` said `"mods":[]`. It is now listed as loaded, with the reason in `problem`, and the console says which mod it is and how to unload it. It is never part of the set a player's app is asked to install.
- The console shows one line, in plain words, when the server-list answer has moved to a spare port. The host log keeps the detailed one.

## Client

No change; the app is rebuilt so both halves carry the same version.
